integrity: The proof is symbolic. A finite independent implementation of the defining divisibilities is included only as corroboration. Literature comparisons distinguish exponential-harmonic types from classical, unitary, bi-unitary, and multiplicative-perfect variants.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to one repeated prime whose exponent is prime and a squarefree coprime cofactor; composite repeated exponents are not classified, and no infinitude claim is made for the two-prime-support subfamily.
title: Prime-exponent squarefree-cofactor strata for exponential harmonic numbers
